firm_data.firm_description: YOUMAN, MADEO & FASANO LLP. is a full-service immigration law firm that provides legal services in deportation/removal defense, green cards, visas, work permits, citizenship, and asylum. They offer innovative and aggressive solutions to immigration law firms, with a focus on innovation and excellence.
notable_facts: The firm's attorneys are members of the American Immigration Lawyers Association.
The firm's attorneys frequently speak before continuing legal education and other groups.
The firm has a reputation for successfully seeking relief for immigrants convicted of serious crimes.

email.subject: AI for YOUMAN, MADEO & FASANO LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Donald,

Your firm's reputation for aggressive deportation defense and relief for complex cases caught my attention. As a 10-attorney practice focused on innovation and excellence, you're exactly the kind of firm that needs tools to scale impact without scaling headcount.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to meet regional firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Queens office to show how we're helping immigration practices manage complex case workflows and discovery more effectively.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
